```{r}
level_order1 <- c('Reference', 'Elevated CO2')

tissue_daa <- ps_gut_clean

sample_data(tissue_daa)$Site <- factor(sample_data(tissue_daa)$Condition, levels = level_order1)

table(sample_data(tissue_daa)$Site)
summary(tissue_daa)
```


```{r}
# ANCOMBC - New Way # KEEP THIS!
library(viridis)

output_daa_tissue_new = ancombc2(data = tissue_daa, assay_name = "counts", tax_level = "Genus",
                  fix_formula = "Site", rand_formula = NULL,
                  p_adj_method = "fdr", pseudo = 0, pseudo_sens = TRUE,
                  prv_cut = 0.01, lib_cut = 0, s0_perc = 0.05,
                  group = "Site", struc_zero = TRUE, neg_lb = FALSE,
                  alpha = 0.05, n_cl = 2, verbose = TRUE,
                  global = TRUE, pairwise = FALSE, dunnet = TRUE, trend = TRUE,
                  iter_control = list(tol = 1e-2, max_iter = 20, 
                                      verbose = TRUE),
                  em_control = list(tol = 1e-5, max_iter = 100),
                  lme_control = lme4::lmerControl(),
                  mdfdr_control = list(fwer_ctrl_method = "fdr", B = 100),
                  trend_control = list(contrast = list(matrix(c(1, 0, -1, 1),
                                                              nrow = 2, 
                                                              byrow = TRUE),
                                                       matrix(c(-1, 0, 1, -1),
                                                              nrow = 2, 
                                                              byrow = TRUE)),
                                       node = list(2, 2),
                                       solver = "ECOS",
                                       B = 100))

# These parameters are less conservative, better for exploratory analyses. 
# alpha (p-cutoff) set at 0.05 rather than 0.001 etc.

# ANCOMBC Bar Plot - All of these are significantly differentially expressed (p < 0.05)

res_prim = output_daa_tissue_new$res
res_prim
df_res = res_prim %>% dplyr::filter(`diff_SiteElevated CO2`) %>%
    dplyr::select(taxon, contains("SiteElevated CO2")) 
# 45 taxa differentially expression (p < 0.05)

View(df_res)

# Arrange in order of lfc
df_fig_res = df_res %>% 
    arrange(desc(`lfc_SiteElevated CO2`
)) %>%
    mutate(direct = ifelse(`lfc_SiteElevated CO2`
 > 0, "Positive LFC", "Negative LFC"))

df_fig_res$taxon = factor(df_fig_res$taxon, levels = df_fig_res$taxon)
df_fig_res$direct = factor(df_fig_res$direct, 
                           levels = c("Positive LFC", "Negative LFC"))

# Set color bounds
lo_val <- floor(min(df_fig_res$`lfc_SiteElevated CO2`))
up_val <- ceiling(max(df_fig_res$`lfc_SiteElevated CO2`))
mid_val <- (lo_val + up_val) / 2

fig_res = df_fig_res %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = taxon, y = `lfc_SiteElevated CO2`, fill = `lfc_SiteElevated CO2`)) + 
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.7, color = "black", 
             position = position_dodge(width = 0.4)) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = `lfc_SiteElevated CO2` - `se_SiteElevated CO2`, ymax = `lfc_SiteElevated CO2` + `se_SiteElevated CO2`), 
                  width = 0.2, position = position_dodge(0.05), color = "black") + 
    labs(x = "Genus", y = "Log fold change") + scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "plasma") + scale_color_viridis_c(option = "plasma") +
  theme_bw() + 
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank()) + coord_flip()

fig_res

# Trying with site colors
fig_res = df_fig_res %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = taxon, y = `lfc_SiteElevated CO2`, fill = `lfc_SiteElevated CO2`)) + 
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.7, color = "black", 
             position = position_dodge(width = 0.4)) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = `lfc_SiteElevated CO2` - `se_SiteElevated CO2`, ymax = `lfc_SiteElevated CO2` + `se_SiteElevated CO2`), 
                  width = 0.2, position = position_dodge(0.05), color = "black") + 
    labs(x = "Genus", y = "Log fold change") + scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#2C728E", high = "#D4476C", mid = "white", 
    na.value = "white", midpoint = mid_val, 
    limit = c(lo_val, up_val), name = NULL
  ) +
  theme_bw() + 
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank()) + coord_flip()

fig_res

ggsave('Figures_Alpha_Beta_div/daa_fig_tissue_lfc_se.svg', width = 20, height = 20, units = 'cm', dpi = 900)

```
# Final plot
```{r}
df_fig_res <- df_fig_res %>%
  mutate(
    direction = ifelse(`lfc_SiteElevated CO2` > 0,
                       "Elevated CO2",
                       "Reference"),
    neglog10_p = -log10(`p_SiteElevated CO2`)
  )

fig_res <- ggplot(
  df_fig_res,
  aes(
    x = taxon,
    y = `lfc_SiteElevated CO2`,
    fill = direction,
    alpha = neglog10_p
  )
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7, colour = "black") +
  geom_errorbar(
  data = df_fig_res,
  inherit.aes = FALSE,
  aes(
    x = taxon,
    ymin = `lfc_SiteElevated CO2` - `se_SiteElevated CO2`,
    ymax = `lfc_SiteElevated CO2` + `se_SiteElevated CO2`
  ),
  colour = "black",
  width = 0.2
) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Reference" = "#2C728E",
      "Elevated CO2" = "#D4476C"
    ),
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  scale_alpha_continuous(
    range = c(0.3, 1),
    name = expression(-log[10]~"adjusted p-value")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Genus",
    y = "Log fold change"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
  panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
  panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
)

fig_res

ggsave('Figures_Alpha_Beta_div/daa_fig_tissue_lfc_se.svg', width = 20, height = 20, units = 'cm', dpi = 900)
```


# ASV-level ANCOMBC
```{r}
# ASV-level ANCOM-BC2
# tax_level = NULL prevents taxonomic aggregation

set.seed(123)

output_daa_asv <- ancombc2(
  data = tissue_daa,
  assay_name = "counts",
  tax_level = NULL,
  fix_formula = "Site",
  rand_formula = NULL,
  p_adj_method = "fdr",
  pseudo = 0,
  pseudo_sens = TRUE,
  prv_cut = 0.01,
  lib_cut = 0,
  s0_perc = 0.05,
  group = "Site",
  struc_zero = TRUE,
  neg_lb = FALSE,
  alpha = 0.05,
  n_cl = 2,
  verbose = TRUE,
  global = FALSE,
  pairwise = FALSE,
  dunnet = FALSE,
  trend = FALSE,
  iter_control = list(
    tol = 1e-2,
    max_iter = 20,
    verbose = TRUE
  ),
  em_control = list(
    tol = 1e-5,
    max_iter = 100
  ),
  lme_control = lme4::lmerControl()
)

library(dplyr)
library(tibble)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Identify significant genera from the original analysis
# ------------------------------------------------------------

sig_genera <- output_daa_tissue_new$res %>%
  filter(`diff_SiteElevated CO2`) %>%
  pull(taxon)

length(sig_genera) # Should be 45


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Extract taxonomy for all original ASVs
# ------------------------------------------------------------

tax_asv <- as.data.frame(tax_table(tissue_daa)) %>%
  rownames_to_column("taxon") %>%
  distinct(taxon, .keep_all = TRUE)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Calculate ASV prevalence in the original dataset
# ------------------------------------------------------------

comm_asv <- as(otu_table(tissue_daa), "matrix")

if (taxa_are_rows(tissue_daa)) {
  comm_asv <- t(comm_asv)
}

asv_prevalence <- data.frame(
  taxon = colnames(comm_asv),
  prevalence = colSums(comm_asv > 0) / nrow(comm_asv),
  total_reads = colSums(comm_asv)
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Extract ASV-level ANCOM-BC2 results
# ------------------------------------------------------------

res_asv <- output_daa_asv$res

# Keep primary results and robustness information if available
res_asv_keep <- res_asv %>%
  select(
    taxon,
    starts_with("lfc_"),
    starts_with("se_"),
    starts_with("q_"),
    starts_with("diff_"),
    starts_with("passed_ss")
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Combine taxonomy, prevalence and ASV-level results
# ------------------------------------------------------------

asv_all <- tax_asv %>%
  filter(Genus %in% sig_genera) %>%
  left_join(asv_prevalence, by = "taxon") %>%
  left_join(res_asv_keep, by = "taxon") %>%
  mutate(
    ASV_tested = taxon %in% res_asv$taxon,
    ASV_detected = prevalence > 0
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. All ASVs belonging to the 45 significant genera
# ------------------------------------------------------------

asv_within_sig_genera <- asv_all %>%
  arrange(Genus, `q_SiteElevated CO2`) %>%
  select(
    taxon,
    Genus,
    Species,
    prevalence,
    total_reads,
    ASV_detected,
    ASV_tested,
    `lfc_SiteElevated CO2`,
    `se_SiteElevated CO2`,
    `q_SiteElevated CO2`,
    `diff_SiteElevated CO2`,
    any_of("diff_robust_SiteElevated CO2")
  )

View(asv_within_sig_genera)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Significant ASVs within significant genera
# ------------------------------------------------------------

sig_asv_within_genera <- asv_within_sig_genera %>%
  filter(`diff_SiteElevated CO2` %in% TRUE) %>%
  arrange(Genus, `q_SiteElevated CO2`) %>%
mutate(
    across(
      where(is.numeric),
      ~ formatC(.x, format = "fg", digits = 3)
    )
  )

View(sig_asv_within_genera)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Summarise ASV-level results within each significant genus
# ------------------------------------------------------------

asv_genus_summary <- asv_within_sig_genera %>%
  group_by(Genus) %>%
  summarise(
    Original_ASVs = n(),
    Detected_ASVs = sum(ASV_detected, na.rm = TRUE),
    ASVs_tested = sum(ASV_tested, na.rm = TRUE),
    ASVs_significant = sum(
      `diff_SiteElevated CO2` %in% TRUE,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    Positive_ASVs = sum(
      `diff_SiteElevated CO2` %in% TRUE &
        `lfc_SiteElevated CO2` > 0,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    Negative_ASVs = sum(
      `diff_SiteElevated CO2` %in% TRUE &
        `lfc_SiteElevated CO2` < 0,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(ASVs_significant)) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      where(is.numeric),
      ~ formatC(.x, format = "fg", digits = 3)
    )
  )

View(asv_genus_summary)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Significant ASVs
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# All significant ASVs across the dataset, regardless of genus-level significance

sig_asv_all <- res_asv_annotated %>%
  filter(`diff_SiteElevated CO2`) %>%
  arrange(`q_SiteElevated CO2`) %>%
  select(
    taxon,
    Genus,
    Species,
    `lfc_SiteElevated CO2`,
    `se_SiteElevated CO2`,
    `q_SiteElevated CO2`,
    `diff_SiteElevated CO2`
  )

write.csv(
  sig_asv_all,
  "ANCOMBC_ASV_summary/All_significant_ASVs.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)


write.csv(
  asv_within_sig_genera,
  "ANCOMBC_ASV_summary/ASV_results_within_45_significant_genera.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  sig_asv_within_genera,
  "ANCOMBC_ASV_summary/Significant_ASVs_within_45_significant_genera.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  asv_genus_summary,
  "ANCOMBC_ASV_summary/ASV_summary_by_significant_genus.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```


# Structural zeroes
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(phyloseq)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Aggregate original phyloseq object to genus level
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ps_genus_ancomb <- tax_glom(
  tissue_daa,
  taxrank = "Genus",
  NArm = TRUE
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Extract genus-level abundance matrix
# ------------------------------------------------------------

otu <- as(otu_table(ps_genus_ancomb), "matrix")

if (taxa_are_rows(ps_genus_ancomb)) {
  otu <- t(otu)
}

# Genus names from taxonomy table
genus_names <- as.character(tax_table(ps_genus_ancomb)[, "Genus"])

# Replace matrix column names with genus names
colnames(otu) <- genus_names

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Calculate prevalence per genus in each condition
# ------------------------------------------------------------

meta <- data.frame(sample_data(ps_genus_ancomb))

meta <- meta[rownames(otu), , drop = FALSE]

otu_pa <- otu > 0

prevalence <- tibble(
  taxon = colnames(otu_pa),
  Reference_prevalence = colMeans(
    otu_pa[meta$Condition == "Reference", , drop = FALSE]
  ) * 100,
  Elevated_CO2_prevalence = colMeans(
    otu_pa[meta$Condition == "Elevated CO2", , drop = FALSE]
  ) * 100
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Join structural-zero genera to prevalence
# ------------------------------------------------------------

supp_structural_zero <- zero_class %>%
  left_join(prevalence, by = "taxon") %>%
  arrange(Structural_zero_condition, taxon)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Format supplementary table
# ------------------------------------------------------------

supp_structural_zero <- supp_structural_zero %>%
  mutate(
    Reference_prevalence = round(Reference_prevalence, 1),
    Elevated_CO2_prevalence = round(Elevated_CO2_prevalence, 1)
  ) %>%
  rename(
    Genus = taxon,
    `Structural-zero condition` = Structural_zero_condition,
    `Reference prevalence (%)` = Reference_prevalence,
    `Elevated CO2 prevalence (%)` = Elevated_CO2_prevalence
  )

supp_structural_zero

write.csv(
  supp_structural_zero,
  "Supplementary_Table_Structural_Zero_Taxa.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)
```


```{r}
# Structural-zero results
output_daa_tissue_new$zero_ind

# Primary DA results
output_daa_tissue_new$res

# Significant primary DA taxa
output_daa_tissue_new$res %>%
  filter(`diff_SiteElevated CO2`)

# Taxa identified as structural zeros
zero_taxa <- output_daa_tissue_new$zero_ind %>%
  filter(`structural_zero (Site = Reference)`)

zero_taxa

zero_taxa_vent <- output_daa_tissue_new$zero_ind %>%
  filter(`structural_zero (Site = Elevated CO2)`)

zero_taxa_vent

zero_ind %>%
  summarise(
    n_reference = sum(`structural_zero (Site = Reference)`),
    n_vent = sum(`structural_zero (Site = Elevated CO2)`),
    n_unique = n_distinct(
      taxon[
        `structural_zero (Site = Reference)` |
        `structural_zero (Site = Elevated CO2)`
      ]
    )
  )
```

```{r}
# Structural zeros in either condition
zero_ind <- output_daa_tissue_new$zero_ind

# Significant model-based DA taxa
sig_da <- output_daa_tissue_new$res %>%
  filter(`diff_SiteElevated CO2`) %>%
  pull(taxon)

# Taxa identified as structural zeros in Reference
zero_ref <- zero_ind %>%
  filter(`structural_zero (Site = Reference)`) %>%
  pull(taxon)

# Taxa identified as structural zeros in Elevated CO2
zero_vent <- zero_ind %>%
  filter(`structural_zero (Site = Elevated CO2)`) %>%
  pull(taxon)

# Overlap with plotted taxa
intersect(sig_da, zero_ref)
intersect(sig_da, zero_vent)
```
